name: lifibav3-desktop-scaffold
description: Windows desktop scaffold with Electron, React, Tailwind v4, SQLite and Python child process bridge

scripts.build: pnpm run build:python && pnpm run build:renderer && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.check:electron: node --check electron/main.js && node --check electron/preload.js && node --check electron/python-bridge.js && node --check scripts/dev-electron.cjs && node --check scripts/smoke-dev.cjs && node --check scripts/smoke-ipc.cjs
scripts.check: pnpm run check:electron && pnpm run check:python && pnpm run build:renderer
